rationale: Builds on the current staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline by adding a late, compile-stable anchor refresh schedule inside the recurrent tail. The decoder-output anchor is no longer fully static: later in training each recurrent block can partially refresh the anchor toward its updated state, which may reduce stale-anchor error accumulation without adding export-sensitive parameters or changing final evaluation/output plumbing. The change is structural, compact, and preserves the existing quant-aware endgame.
title: Staged Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Curriculum
